description: Holds space at a lot for the driver for a few minutes and returns booking_url, the lot's pay page on parkgraph.com (opened on duration_hours when it is sent). No API key needed. A hold takes a real space until it expires or the driver pays. Lots that take payment at their QR page place no hold: the result is status pay_at_qr_page with a pay_url, the lot's pay page. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

agent_platform.description: The calling assistant's platform (recorded on the booking)

duration_hours.description: Hours to book. The result's booking_url opens the lot's pay page on this length

idempotency_key.description: A repeated key retries safely. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

intent.description: What the driver needs, in plain words (optional)

plate.description: Plate to pre-fill on the pay page

ttl_seconds.description: How long the hold lasts, in seconds

name: reserve
title: Reserve a space
